# Vendored dependencies

These are offline copies of well-known open-source libraries used by the web
UI. They are committed to the repo so the app needs no CDN at runtime.

## marked — Markdown parser
- Files: `marked.min.js`
- Version: 12.0.2
- License: MIT
- Copyright (c) 2011-2024 Christopher Jeffrey
- Project: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- License text: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/blob/master/LICENSE.md
- Banner confirming the license is included at the top of `marked.min.js`.

## DOMPurify — HTML sanitizer
- Files: `purify.min.js`
- Version: 3.1.6
- License: Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 (dual)
- Copyright (c) Cure53 and other contributors
- Project: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- License text: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/blob/main/LICENSE
- Banner confirming the license is included at the top of `purify.min.js`.
